summary: 2010 ADA Standards, section 405: running slope no steeper than 1:12 (1 in of rise per 12 in of run); rise per run 30 in (760 mm) at most; clear width 36 in (915 mm) at least; level landings top and bottom, 60 in (1525 mm) long at least; handrails both sides when the rise is over 6 in, gripping surface 34 to 38 in (865 to 965 mm) high; cross slope 1:48 at most. The library piece uses a 12 in (0.305 m) rise, so a 3.66 m run plus a 1.52 m top landing, 1.22 m wide overall, with handrails at 0.91 m. Both pages were reported opened by a second research engine, not by Claude (no web access in the build sandbox); the 1:12 and 36 in figures match the public standard.
